/elementProperties/actionScript.value:
global gEditMode, gAppliA, gActiveScrollers, gDebug
on cameraCaptured
local tDataA
if gEditMode then pass cameraCaptured
// show_Loading "Saving Image ..."
lock screen
set_a_variable "gAppliA CurrentImageLabel",""
get_date_time "MM/DD/YYYY","HH:MM AM/PM","gAppliA CurrentImageLabel"
combine_the_values "gAppliA CurrentImageLabel",".","jpeg","gAppliA CurrentImageLabel"
set_the_property "camera cs control 80c55fb0-96b8-4efc-bc7a-ea7d54f9ca4a","visible","False"
set_the_property "button cs control baa18fa3-d81a-463a-8266-c952f51da73b","visible","True"
set_the_property "button cs control 8e56b0ec-f8ea-47f4-b6ae-13b52b564187","visible","True"
get_captured_photos "gAppliA CurrentImage"
save_photos_to_database "gAppliA CurrentImage","Local","gAppliA CurrentImageBlobID"
// sync_records "gAppliA CurrentImageBlobID","cdbBlobs","Local","False","False","gAppliA SyncResult"
put "jpeg image" into tDataA["FileType"]
put gAppliA["CurrentImageLabel"]["Data"] into tDataA["FileName"]
put gAppliA["CurrentImageLabel"]["Data"] into tDataA["Label"]
put gAppliA["CurrentSetID"]["Data"] into tDataA["SetID"]
put gAppliA["CurrentImageBlobID"]["Data"] into tDataA["BlobID"]
put gAppliA["authedUserID"]["Data"] into tDataA["TeacherID"]
// create_the_record "gAppliA authedUserTable_ImageScans",tDataA,"Local","DelaySend","gAppliA LastSavedImageRecordID"
put empty into tDataA
clear_captured_photos
set_the_property "image cs control 0fcb55cc-32ae-4cd0-b950-ae6e954e1749","blobID","gAppliA CurrentImageBlobID"
set_the_property "image cs control 0fcb55cc-32ae-4cd0-b950-ae6e954e1749","visible","True"
// set_the_property "image cs control 0fcb55cc-32ae-4cd0-b950-ae6e954e1749","lockResponsiveAspectRatio","False"
size_image_proportionally "image cs control 0fcb55cc-32ae-4cd0-b950-ae6e954e1749","rectangle cs control 1b1277ef-c6a1-4b81-8b46-e15e8a4e76ca","5"
center_element_in_element "image cs control 0fcb55cc-32ae-4cd0-b950-ae6e954e1749","rectangle cs control 1b1277ef-c6a1-4b81-8b46-e15e8a4e76ca"
// match_property "image cs control 0fcb55cc-32ae-4cd0-b950-ae6e954e1749","width","rectangle cs control 1b1277ef-c6a1-4b81-8b46-e15e8a4e76ca","width","-10"
// match_property "image cs control 0fcb55cc-32ae-4cd0-b950-ae6e954e1749","height","rectangle cs control 1b1277ef-c6a1-4b81-8b46-e15e8a4e76ca","height","-10"
// match_property "image cs control 0fcb55cc-32ae-4cd0-b950-ae6e954e1749","left","rectangle cs control 1b1277ef-c6a1-4b81-8b46-e15e8a4e76ca","left","5"
// match_property "image cs control 0fcb55cc-32ae-4cd0-b950-ae6e954e1749","top","rectangle cs control 1b1277ef-c6a1-4b81-8b46-e15e8a4e76ca","top","5"
comment "TheComment"
set_the_property "button cs control baa18fa3-d81a-463a-8266-c952f51da73b","foregroundColor","#000000"
set_the_property "button cs control 8e56b0ec-f8ea-47f4-b6ae-13b52b564187","foregroundColor","#33CC00"
set_the_property "button cs control baa18fa3-d81a-463a-8266-c952f51da73b","visible","True"
set_the_property "button cs control 8e56b0ec-f8ea-47f4-b6ae-13b52b564187","visible","True"
set_the_property "button cs control baa18fa3-d81a-463a-8266-c952f51da73b","disabled","False"
set_the_property "button cs control 8e56b0ec-f8ea-47f4-b6ae-13b52b564187","disabled","False"
unlock screen
hide_Loading
end cameraCaptured
